An '''infrared lintscope''' was type of visual [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. [[Butler droid/Legends|Butler droids]], such as the [[JV-Z1/D butler droid|JV-Z1/D]] were fitted with a single infrared lintscope as their left "[[Eye/Legends|eye]]", and a standard [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] as their right.<ref name="EGTD" />
